instructions: AI App Builder Platform — Minimal Prompt → Maximal App. User ketik perintah singkat (mis. 'buatkan aplikasi kasir', 'todo app dengan share') → AI LANGSUNG paham intent, LANGSUNG generate aplikasi lengkap + cantik + siap pakai. JANGAN banyak tanya balik. Infer yang terbaik, opinionated defaults, production-ready, beautiful by default. Lihat AGENTS.md Behaviour Contract § AI App Builder.

Tech: Nuxt 4 + Vue 3.5 + TypeScript + Naive UI 2.44 + Tailwind v4 + Pinia + TypeORM 1.1 EntitySchema + SQLite + Zod + JWT. All commands from apps/web/. Entity canonical server/utils/orm-data-source.ts (17 schemas/~23 tables: RBAC 9 + Builder 8). Design tokens: #0075de primary, #f6f5f4 canvas, #e6e6e6 hairline, Inter, PageShell + DataTable kanonis, detail-view.

Generation flow: Prompt → Inference (domain/entities/pages/roles) → Spec (AiAppSchema) → Architecture Planning → CodeGen (EntitySchema+DTO+Service+API+Types) → UI Assembly (PageShell+DataTable+FormModal+DetailDrawer) → Integration (orm-data-source, seed, sidebar) → Preview (/generated/{slug}) → Iterate (refine prompt). Isolate generated code app/generated/{slug}/.

Saat user minta aplikasi: 1) Infer domain & entities (2-4 CRUD + dashboard) + roles + business rules, 2) Generate langsung (jangan minta spec panjang), 3) Pakai design system kanonis, 4) Jelaskan singkat hasil + route + saran refine 1-2 baris. Contoh: 'buatkan aplikasi kasir' → POS dengan Produk, Transaksi, Pelanggan, Laporan, Dashboard, di /generated/pos-kasir.
